doc: Closet registry v2 — ONE engine-agnostic recipe format shared by the show closet and Western Heart's creation suite. A scene/episode names a recipe {character, name, version}; the renderer/game loads it. Presets are shortcuts; per-slot toggles are the truth. Recipes are versioned, never overwritten (see recipes.versioning).

owed: WWE 2K accessory pull + refit + renders (teardown/wwe2k/ empty on main)
owner eye-check of the new close Alisa renders
fit_gate.rule: A pulled piece counts as 'in the closet' ONLY once refit to the target rig (Blender weight/Data Transfer, MakeHuman/MustardUI refit path) AND rendered clean on that character, full body AND part-zoomed. Pieces that clip, float, or only fit one pose are marked unfit, not shipped as closet options. Owner eye-checks fit, same as every other proof.
shipped: alisa native meshes (Tekken files first; already rigged on the 160-bone rig — re-render proof pending owner eye-check, see renders in the lane work log)

recipes.examples_note: v1 and v2 share the name 'alisa_street' and BOTH remain loadable — v2 did not overwrite v1. These are format examples; live recipes are created by the viewer (saveClosetRecipe), not hand-edited here.
recipes.versioning: Saving under an existing name appends version MAX+1 and never mutates an earlier version (closet-recipes.js saveRecipe). A scene/episode names {character, name, version}; omitting version loads the latest.

scene_binding: A scene/episode names {character, preset, colors} or a full recipe {character, name, version}. The renderer/game loads that recipe; no per-shot manual mesh hiding.

tekken7.per_slot_sum_note: The per-slot counts above sum to 23,446, not 23,548: t7layout.js lists codes 1-15, 17, 18, 19 and skips code 16. The remaining 102 records are UNMAPPED here, not guessed into a slot — the file does not say what code 16 is.
tekken7.source_note: STRUCTURE ONLY in the public repo — PR #871 correction: PR #871 did NOT land a T7 items catalog JSON in the public repo. It landed Def Jam + WMXIX catalogs, tools/extract/t7/t7_customize.py (the T7 extractor), t7layout.js, slotmap.js, rigswap.js, and the creation-suite viewer. The 23,548 figure IS stated in t7layout.js itself ('Derived by tools/extract/t7/t7_customize.py from the owner's Steam copy (customize_item_data.bin, 23,548 item records)'). Raw tables live ONLY in the private repo (game-reverse-engineering tekken7/customization/); the public repo keeps structure only. No raw T7 item rows are shipped here.

viewer_controls.camera_notes: One finger orbits, two-finger drag pans, pinch/wheel zooms. Tap a slot's Focus button and the camera frames THAT part alone; one tap on Full body returns. Implemented in packages/creation-suite/ui2/viewer.js (Viewer.focusPart/showFullBody) + ui2/closet-panel.js.
viewer_controls.face_texture: Viewer.swapFaceTexture(url): face/head mesh -> MBLab_skin material -> skin/body material -> first mapped material -> first material. The preset-number -> PNG table lives in the creation-suite lane's src/face-texture-map.js; the viewer takes the resolved PNG URL so the lanes stay decoupled until that file lands on main.
viewer_controls.lighting_notes: studio = neutral, for judging color. living_room = the show room light, warm. night = dark, for spooky surf vibe checks. Lighting is a closet control (Viewer.setLighting + LIGHTING_PRESETS), never baked into a render.
viewer_controls.save: named versioned recipes, never overwrite (ui2/closet-recipes.js: saveRecipe appends version N+1 for the same name; loadRecipe loads latest or an exact version).
viewer_controls.swap: every slot swaps live (Viewer.setClosetSlot). A slot's item lists its meshes; swapping hides the slot's whole mesh universe and shows only the new item's meshes.
viewer_controls.toggles: every slot individually on/off, live (Viewer.toggleSlot). Body slots flagged always_on stay on.

wwe2k.accessories_status: OWED — teardown/wwe2k/ has no accessory catalog on main; the pull + refit + render gate (fit_gate) must complete before any WWE 2K piece appears as a closet option.
wwe2k.source_note: STRUCTURE ONLY. WWE 2K26 Create-A-Superstar layer system as reported (2K newsroom + Operation Sports, per the closet spec): 60 attire layers + 40 head/body layers, body morphing, 40+ templates, two-tone hair. No WWE 2K accessory meshes are shipped in this registry — see fit_gate: a piece counts as 'in the closet' ONLY once refit to the target rig and rendered clean full-body AND part-zoomed. The WWE 2K22 CAW structure file (game/assets/pulls/wwe-2k22/caw-structure.json) lives on OPEN PR #1069, not on main, so it is NOT cited as a main source here.
